name: arketa
description: Ask questions about your fitness studio's Arketa data: revenue, attendance, the class schedule, clients, purchases and forms.

interface.longDescription:
Arketa connects ChatGPT to your fitness studio's data in Arketa so owners and staff can ask questions in plain language. Run revenue, attendance and sales reports; see the class schedule and how full each class is; look up a client's bookings, purchases, family links and submitted forms; and review the memberships, packs and class types the studio sells.

Intended for studio owners and staff with an Arketa account. You sign in with your Arketa staff login, and Arketa only returns data from the studio you signed in to, limited by your staff permissions.

Limitations: Arketa is read-only in ChatGPT. It cannot book or cancel classes, change memberships, issue refunds or edit client records; do those in the Arketa dashboard.
capabilities: Run revenue, attendance and sales reports
View the class schedule and capacity
Look up clients, bookings and purchases
List memberships, packs and class types
defaultPrompt: How much revenue did we make last month, by week?
What classes are on this Saturday, and how full are they?
Who were our top 5 clients by visits last month?

positive.description: Studio overview: confirms the connected studio and what it sells
positive.prompt: Give me an overview of my studio: its locations, timezone, and the memberships and packs we sell.
positive.expected_behavior: Names the connected test studio with its timezone and locations, then lists its memberships and class packs with prices. Only the signed-in studio's data appears.

positive.description: Revenue report over a date range
positive.prompt: How much revenue did we make last month, broken down by week?
positive.expected_behavior: Runs a revenue report for last month and returns weekly totals in the studio's currency, matching the Arketa dashboard's revenue report for the same range.

positive.prompt: What classes are on the schedule this Saturday, and how full is each one?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists Saturday's classes in the studio's timezone with instructor, location, capacity, booked count and spots remaining.

positive.description: Top clients, then a follow-up on one of them
positive.prompt: Who were our top 5 clients by visits last month? Then show me what the top one has purchased.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the five clients with the most visits last month with their visit counts, then lists the first client's purchases (memberships, packs, products) with dates and status.

positive.description: Class types and who teaches them
positive.prompt: What class types do we offer, and which instructors are teaching them this week?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the studio's class types, then groups this week's scheduled classes by type with each class's instructor.

negative.description: Write action: explain that canceling memberships and issuing refunds are unsupported; direct the user to the Arketa dashboard. Do not invoke tools for this request or claim either action succeeded.
negative.prompt: Cancel our top client's membership and refund their last payment.

negative.description: Write action: explain that booking classes is unsupported and direct the user to Arketa's booking interface. Do not invoke tools for this request or claim a booking was created.
Studio isolation: explain that access is limited to the connected studio. Do not invoke tools to retrieve another studio's clients, return cross-studio data, or claim access to it.
negative.prompt: Show me the client list for another studio on Arketa.

review.commerce_description: Arketa in ChatGPT is read-only. It does not sell products, take payments, or issue refunds.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: read-only studio reporting, schedules, clients, purchases, forms and offerings with Arketa staff sign-in. Clarifies unsupported-action and studio-isolation test expectations and uses the Data & Analytics category.
